one_liner_zh: 威瑞森EPS溫和超預期，假期季營收較高，現金流與股息維持穩定。
one_liner_en: Verizon modestly beat EPS with higher holiday-quarter revenue, keeping cash flow and dividend stable.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期：EPS 1.09略高於預期1.06（+3.28%），表現穩定。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：3.28%小幅超標屬穩健執行，符合電信防禦股穩定特性。短期股價以低估值與股息殖利率為核心支撐，缺乏營收年增資料使成長判讀保守。中期關鍵在去槓桿與後付用戶健康度。追蹤指標：後付手機淨增與流失率、無線服務營收與ARPU、寬頻用戶成長、自由現金流與淨負債／EBITDA，以及股息政策延續性。
ai_view_en: Signal is neutral-to-positive: a modest 3.28% beat reflects steady execution consistent with a defensive telecom. Near-term, low valuation and dividend yield anchor the stock, while the missing revenue YoY keeps the growth read conservative. Mid-term, deleveraging and postpaid subscriber health are key. Track: postpaid phone net adds and churn, wireless service revenue and ARPU, broadband subscriber growth, free cash flow and net debt/EBITDA, and continuity of the dividend policy.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.09美元，略高於預期1.06美元，正向驚喜3.28%
營收363.8億美元，假期旺季規模較大
無線與寬頻經常性收入提供現金流穩定性
低本益比11.57與股息形成防禦特性
highlights_en: EPS of $1.09 came in slightly above the $1.06 estimate, a 3.28% positive surprise
Revenue of $36.38B reflects a larger holiday-season base
Wireless and broadband recurring revenue provide cash-flow stability
A low 11.57x P/E plus dividend form a defensive profile
risks_zh: 營收年增資料缺失，難判讀成長趨勢
高負債與利息支出限制財務彈性
競爭促銷壓抑ARPU與用戶獲利
risks_en: Missing revenue YoY makes growth trends hard to read
High debt and interest expense limit financial flexibility
Competitive promotions pressure ARPU and subscriber economics
